---
title: Sardine Cutlets
id: MAR-0006
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 600 g sardines
- 3 eggs
- 80 g breadcrumbs
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Scale the sardines, bone them by opening them like a book, and wash them.
2. Dry them with paper towels.
3. Crack the eggs into a deep plate, salt them, and beat them with a fork.
4. Dip the sardines in the eggs, then in the breadcrumbs, and press them lightly with your hands so the breading adheres well.
5. Fry them in hot oil, a few at a time.
6. Drain them, place them on paper towels, salt them, and serve.
